Step 1: Calculate the total cost of the rope Sarah bought.
Sarah bought the rope for $2 a meter, and the rope is 20 meters long.
Total cost = 20 meters * $2/meter = $40

Step 2: Calculate the total cost of the new rope Sarah wants to buy.
The new rope costs $1.5 a meter, and Sarah wants to buy 20 meters.
Total cost = 20 meters * $1.5/meter = $30

Step 3: Calculate the profit Sarah will have after buying the new rope.
Profit = Total cost of the rope Sarah bought - Total cost of the new rope
Profit = $40 - $30 = $10

Step 4: Calculate the amount of money Sarah will have left over after buying the new rope.
Sarah will have $10 left over after buying the new rope.
